Title: Azure SQL Data Warehouse enables streaming solutions with Azure Databricks

Body.Content:
Azure Databricks integration

Azure SQL Data Warehouse is a fast, flexible and secure platform for analytics. Starting today, Azure SQL Data Warehouse (SQL DW) customers can build near real-time analytics solutions with tighter integration with Azure Databricks. We have enabled improved integration that allows you to ingest live streaming data from Azure Databricks to SQL DW to easily build BI dashboards. Data captured from any IoT device, or logs from website clickstreams, can be processed it in near-real time within Azure Databricks and the insights can be shared across your organization through Azure SQL Data Warehouse, making the data accessible using SQL Dew’s industry-leading query performance and query concurrency.

 

​Learn More
